name: Planar Nexus — "This land is every nonbasic land type"
notes: Open since 2026-11-22. The sentence was read as a plain set of the Land type and gave no subtypes. It now gives every official land subtype that is not a basic land type, read from TypeCatalog as the effect applies (so a new nonbasic land type needs no update), and no basic land mana ability.

$includes: {1}, {T}: Add one mana of any color.
